chapter.heading: Job’s Discourse on Wisdom
chapter.v:
“Surely there
is a mine for silver,And a place where gold is refined. [[Matt. 5:28]]

Iron is
taken from the earth,And copper is smelted from ore. [Job 20:29]

Man puts
an end to darkness,And searches every recessFor ore in the darkness and the shadow of death.

He breaks
open a shaft away from people;In places forgotten by feetThey hang far away from men;They swing to and fro. [[2 Chr. 16:9]; Job 24:23; 28:24; 34:21; 36:7; [Prov. 5:21; 15:3; Jer.]

As for
the earth, from it comes bread,But underneath it is turned up as by fire;

Its stones
are the source of sapphires,And it contains gold dust. [Job 23:10; 27:5,]

That path
no bird knows,Nor has the falcon’s eye seen it. [Num. 15:39; [Eccl. 11:9]; Ezek. 6:9; [Matt. 5:29]]

The proud
lions have not trodden it,Nor has the fierce lion passed over it. [Lev. 26:16; Deut. 28:30, 38; Job 20:18; Mic.]

He puts
his hand on the flint;He overturns the mountains at the roots.

He cuts
out channels in the rocks,And his eye sees every precious thing. [Deut. 28:30;]

He dams
up the streams from trickling;What is hidden he brings forth to light. [Gen. 38:24; [Lev. 20:10; Deut. 22:22]; Job 31:28]

“Butwhere can
wisdom be found?And where is the place of understanding?

Man does
not know its value,Nor is it found in the land of the living. [[Deut. 24:14,]

The deep
says, ‘It is not in me’;And the sea says, ‘It is not with me.’ [[Ps. 44:21]]

It cannot
be purchased for gold,Nor can silver be weighed for its price. [Job 34:19; Prov. 14:31; 22:2; [Mal. 2:10]]

It cannot
be valued in the gold of Ophir,In precious onyx or sapphire. [Job 29:12]

Neither gold
nor crystal can equal it,Nor can it be exchanged for jewelry of fine gold.

No mention
shall be made of coral or quartz,For the price of wisdom is above rubies.

The topaz
of Ethiopia cannot equal it,Nor can it be valued in pure gold.

“Fromwhere then
does wisdom come?And where is the place of understanding? [[Deut. 24:13]]

It is
hidden from the eyes of all living,And concealed from the birds of the air. [Job 22:9]

Destruction and
Death say,‘We have heard a report about it with our ears.’

God understands
its way,And He knows its place. [Is. 13:6]

For He
looks to the ends of the earth,And sees under the whole heavens, [[Matt. 6:19, 20; Mark 10:23-25]]

To establish
a weight for the wind,And apportion the waters by measure.

When He
made a law for the rain,And a path for the thunderbolt, [[Deut. 4:19; 17:3]; Ezek. 8:16]

Then He
saw wisdom and declared it;He prepared it, indeed, He searched it out.

And to
man He said,‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom,And to depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
